review_summary.decision: retain global-75% extractive compression as an experiment; do not integrate into production

reviews.notes: Mechanism remained correct and concise despite lower lexical-overlap proxy.
Predicted queries and document append operation survived.
CCPairs supervision answer became more direct.
Large-training-data regime and supporting scale survived.
BRIGHT was absent from retrieved sources. Baseline abstained; compressed generation misattributed a HyDE passage and made a claim contradicted by verified BRIGHT evidence.
Best model families and computational-cost drawback survived.
Delayed interaction rationale survived; explicit MaxSim detail was omitted.
Both conditions distinguished published experimental parameters from project-specific recommendations.
Both conditions correctly reported missing energy evidence.

limitations: Ten questions are insufficient for a general answer-quality estimate.
Original generation always ran before compressed generation, so latency is order-confounded.
Citation syntax and lexical overlap do not establish claim entailment.
The multi-source failure began with an upstream top-five retrieval miss.
